concepts.title: Vertical reference circle
concepts.instruction: Construct the 50 mm enclosing square and circle in elevation, with the edge plan below XY.

concepts.title: Vertical isometric rhombus
concepts.instruction: Map the enclosing square into a vertical isometric rhombus and identify its four side midpoints.

concepts.title: Find four arc centres
concepts.instruction: From the obtuse corners draw the centre-finding lines to opposite side midpoints. Their intersections provide the other two centres.

concepts.title: Four vertical arcs
concepts.instruction: Draw the four circular arcs individually between successive tangency midpoints, keeping their centre lines.

concepts.title: Horizontal reference circle
concepts.instruction: Draw the 50 mm circle in plan, its enclosing square and the edge elevation.

concepts.title: Horizontal isometric rhombus
concepts.instruction: Draw the horizontal rhombus, locate the four side midpoints and construct the four arc centres.

concepts.title: Four horizontal arcs
concepts.instruction: Draw each of the four tangent arcs separately and retain A, B, C, D and diameter annotations.

notes: The requested four-centre oval is an approximation to the mathematical isometric ellipse. Preserve its actual source curves; do not substitute a generic SVG ellipse and claim the four-centre method.
A continuous visible circle or oval in the PDF may have four Bezier subsegments in one path. Expose the four principal arc portions as steps if possible.
